description: Enhanced boundary coverage for SOLID reads (native-disjoint). The native suite only exercises a bare SOLID; these add a thickness-only record and a record combining thickness with a non-default extrusion direction (group codes 39 and 210/220/230, which behave identically to the proven LINE/CIRCLE thickness and extrusion handling). The four corners remain at the origin.
